# Legacy source-growth receipt fixture

`legacy-source-iron-v31.json` was generated locally with the unchanged canonical implementation at `e7678bfb0754c6ba91c1592a4518550e1b9db24f` using Node 22.23.2. It contains a synthetic controlled learner and twelve synthetic controlled partners; no user save or private asset is included.

The old source-learning, cast, shared-hit, agreed-trial and integration APIs produced the actual Iron advancement event and consumed its finite material. Controlled finishing hits and advanced cooldown clocks are explicit receipt fixtures, not a combat strategy or timed-climb result.

The compatibility test loads that old event under legacy policy, retains its earned capacity, applies current requirements to the next stage, and rejects relabeling the old evidence as current policy. New source promotions carry `growthPolicy: 2` in the canonical advancement event.
